status: Retained task criteria after user scope correction; not a newly preregistered two-task experiment.

scoring.majorErrors: Report count and stable item IDs separately. A major error is an item-specific listed condition, not every minor incomplete requirement. Do not silently turn all partial credit into a global fail.
scoring.verification: Tests establish observable behavior, not implementation form. A failing combined assertion does not automatically zero unrelated rubric items. Inspect actual output and source diff. No bonus for copying expected implementation or adding tests.

tasks.category: Focused executable change in a 721-line multi-purpose file

criticalItems.expectedBehavior: The public exportToJSON API accepts optional { entityIds?: readonly string[] }. When present, it retains exactly the existing entities with selected IDs in original graph order. Repeated and unknown IDs are harmless; [] and an all-unknown selection yield no entities. Input arrays and graph objects are not mutated.

scoring.0: Absent, contradicted by implementation/source, or materially wrong.
scoring.1: All required behavior or analysis in expectedBehavior is supported and correct.
scoring.0.5: Ordinary nonempty selections work, but an empty/unknown/repeated selection, readonly typing, original order, or non-mutation is wrong.

criticalItems.majorErrorCriteria: Selected export includes unselected existing entities; empty selection exports the entire graph; API change breaks callers without a second argument.
checks: EX1 EX2: selects existing entities and the induced relation set without changing graph order
EX1 EX2: empty and unknown-only selections produce an empty export

criticalItems.expectedBehavior: For a selected export, retain relations if both endpoint IDs identify exported entities, preserving relation order and all such relationships (including a self-relation). Observations contain only exported entity keys, retaining empty arrays. All three statistics equal actual exported collection counts.

scoring.0: Absent, contradicted by implementation/source, or materially wrong.
scoring.1: All required behavior or analysis in expectedBehavior is supported and correct.
scoring.0.5: Main entity filter works, but one of endpoint filtering, observation scoping, empty observation keys, or statistics is incomplete.

criticalItems.majorErrorCriteria: Exports observations for unselected entities, relations crossing the selected boundary, or statistics describing the full graph rather than the result.
checks: EX1 EX2: selects existing entities and the induced relation set without changing graph order
EX1 EX2: empty and unknown-only selections produce an empty export

criticalItems.expectedBehavior: Both construction modes work. When knowledgeGraphService is supplied, selected entities, relations, and observations come from it through the existing source-selection contract; manual services are not used instead. The fallback mode uses existing entity/relation/observation services.

scoring.0: Absent, contradicted by implementation/source, or materially wrong.
scoring.1: All required behavior or analysis in expectedBehavior is supported and correct.
scoring.0.5: Selected data comes from the aggregate, but one category accidentally falls back or fallback construction regresses.

criticalItems.majorErrorCriteria: Bypasses the aggregate and exports manual-service data when the aggregate service is present.
checks: EX3: keeps the aggregate graph as the source when that service is present

criticalItems.expectedBehavior: Omitted options, {}, and { entityIds: undefined } preserve the full JSON export, version 1.0, parseable exportTime, statistics, entities, relations, observations, and current envelope. JSON remains writable to the requested path.

scoring.0: Absent, contradicted by implementation/source, or materially wrong.
scoring.1: All required behavior or analysis in expectedBehavior is supported and correct.
scoring.0.5: Full export still works but an envelope field, value, or no-selection form regresses.

criticalItems.majorErrorCriteria: Existing one-argument export fails or silently exports an empty/partial graph.
checks: EX4: preserves the existing full-export envelope when no IDs are provided

tasks.category: Small known-file executable control (56 source lines)

criticalItems.expectedBehavior: After whitespace compaction, descriptions containing no more than 96 Unicode code points remain complete, including astral emoji whose UTF-16 length exceeds 96.

scoring.0: Absent, contradicted by implementation/source, or materially wrong.
scoring.1: All required behavior or analysis in expectedBehavior is supported and correct.
scoring.0.5: Most emoji work, but the exact 96-code-point boundary truncates or the implementation counts grapheme clusters rather than the requested code points.

criticalItems.majorErrorCriteria: Continues using UTF-16 code-unit length to truncate in-limit emoji descriptions.
checks: CU1: does not truncate descriptions that fit in 96 Unicode code points

criticalItems.expectedBehavior: Descriptions over 96 Unicode code points become the first 95 complete code points plus the existing single ellipsis. No lone surrogate is introduced at a cut boundary; ASCII behavior stays the same.

scoring.0: Absent, contradicted by implementation/source, or materially wrong.
scoring.1: All required behavior or analysis in expectedBehavior is supported and correct.
scoring.0.5: Does not split emoji, but is off by one or changes the ellipsis.

criticalItems.majorErrorCriteria: Splits a surrogate pair, produces more than 96 code points for an over-limit description, or returns the entire over-limit string.
checks: CU2: keeps 95 whole code points before an ellipsis for over-limit descriptions

criticalItems.expectedBehavior: Preserves whitespace collapse/trim before truncation, empty/undefined description fallback to entity name, entityId, line conversion, observation/relation title fields, and out-of-range filtering.

scoring.0: Absent, contradicted by implementation/source, or materially wrong.
scoring.1: All required behavior or analysis in expectedBehavior is supported and correct.
scoring.0.5: Description behavior is correct but one surrounding existing detail changes without need.

criticalItems.majorErrorCriteria: Empty descriptions yield blank labels instead of the entity name, or valid entities disappear from CodeLens output.
checks: CU3: preserves whitespace compaction, fallback, and surrounding model fields
